name: neutral-boundaries
why: The near misses, all in one tree, because each of them is a way a deliverable could silently leave review. `docs-internal/` is not `docs/`. `docs/reportsx.md` is not inside `docs/reports/`. `telemetry/delivery-runsX/` is a different directory from `telemetry/delivery-runs/`. And `docs\reports\x.html` is one file name containing backslashes — a legal, distinct path that no separator rewriting may fold onto the excluded `docs/reports/x.html`, because folding it would drop a real file out of the reviewed deliverable entirely.
